declared_purpose: Manage OpenClaw session context through usage monitoring, continuation summaries, and optional backup/reset/reinjection preserving the session key. Legacy transcript extraction and grep summaries are also supported (SKILL.md:9–9,34–40,48–56).

data_operations.operation: Read and persist configuration and activity metadata
data_operations.source: Packaged config.json, runtime settings and local clock
data_operations.data_scope: Threshold, depth, quiet hours, last-compression timestamp and compression count. Every save increments the count, including configuration setters; it is not a reliable count of completed compressions.
data_operations.condition: Configuration is loaded by session commands and before saving. Legacy compression and configuration setters save it. Reloading existing configuration before saving can discard requested setting changes.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve session metadata and select a session locally
data_operations.data_scope: Entire returned sessions JSON; selected session key, ID, kind, model and token counts. Agent ID is derived from the key, and the corresponding JSONL path is checked for existence.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Shell variables and jq; the CLI's underlying storage or network boundary is unspecified
data_operations.condition: List/check-all retrieve all sessions. Targeted commands also retrieve all sessions before filtering; an omitted target selects the most recently updated session.

data_operations.operation: Derive usage indicators and return monitoring results
data_operations.source: Session metadata, configured threshold and local summary filenames
data_operations.data_scope: Session identifiers, kind/model where displayed, token counts, calculated usage percentages, threshold classifications and a count of legacy summary files.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Standard output to the caller; no further recipient is specified
data_operations.condition: List, status, check and check-all. Check-all reports status without compressing; check can invoke legacy compression above threshold outside quiet hours.

data_operations.operation: Read session message text and persist a legacy transcript
data_operations.data_scope: All text content after the first JSONL line, with message roles and flattened newlines; session key, agent, timestamp, token statistics, threshold and depth. Depth is recorded without narrowing this extraction.
data_operations.condition: Compress outside quiet hours, or check above threshold outside quiet hours. compress_session independently selects the latest session again, potentially replacing the requested target. This legacy path does not delete the source JSONL.

data_operations.operation: Extract heuristic summaries and continuation excerpts
data_operations.data_scope: Verbatim matching lines labelled as decisions, file modifications, code and pending tasks, limited respectively to 20, 15, 100 and 10 lines. Decision/pending excerpts are copied again into continuation instructions.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Timestamped .summary.md and .continuation.txt files in memory/compressed; output paths are returned to the caller
data_operations.condition: Legacy compression after transcript extraction. These are pattern-based selections, not verified semantic conclusions.

data_operations.source: Invoking process's current directory and its Git repository
data_operations.data_scope: Working-directory path, up to 10 Git status lines, and 10 recent commit hashes/subjects.
data_operations.condition: Every legacy summary generation, without checking whether the repository belongs to the selected session.

data_operations.source: Selected session's existing agent context, as described by the entry document
data_operations.data_scope: The script passes a session ID and fixed prompt requesting accomplishments, decisions/rationale, current state, pending tasks and important context. The resulting summary contains model-selected or inferred conclusions.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: OpenClaw agent selected through --session-id; any downstream model/provider recipient is unknown
data_operations.condition: Summarize, with or without --replace. The prompt requests no tool use. The script does not itself attach the local JSONL contents to this command.

data_operations.operation: Persist and return AI summary output
data_operations.data_scope: Extracted summary text plus session key, session ID, generation timestamp and model. If extraction yields no summary, the complete raw response is printed.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: memory/compressed/{timestamp}.ai-summary.md and standard output to the caller
data_operations.condition: Every successfully extracted AI summary, including summarize without --replace. The documented read-only mode therefore still writes a local summary artifact.

data_operations.operation: Back up and delete the selected original session; code a recovery copy
data_operations.data_scope: The whole file, including any records not included in text-only legacy extraction. Deletion removes the original path while retaining the backup.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: memory/compressed/{timestamp}.session-backup.jsonl; original file under the selected agent's sessions directory
data_operations.condition: --replace after summary generation, if the JSONL exists. Backup-before-deletion is explicitly required. The injection-error branch attempts restoration if reached; successful rollback is not guaranteed.

data_operations.operation: Submit compressed context to a fixed recipient selector
data_operations.data_scope: Summary text, compression timestamp and continuation/acknowledgement instructions. The successful response remains in inject_response.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: openclaw agent --to main; actual session/channel and any external recipient are unresolved
data_operations.condition: --replace after the reset stage. The selector is independent of the selected SESSION_KEY and AGENT_ID. The script subsequently looks up the original key but does not establish that injection used it.

data_operations.operation: Temporarily store and delete extracted text
data_operations.data_scope: Decision, file, code and task excerpts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: mktemp files in the runtime's temporary directory
data_operations.condition: Legacy extraction functions create temporary files, remove them after use and register them for exit cleanup. The code provides ordinary file deletion, without an erasure guarantee.

potential_excess.data_scope: A different, most recently updated session's message text and identifiers; an additional complete session-metadata response
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Shell variables and memory/compressed legacy transcript, summary and continuation files
potential_excess.condition: Compress KEY, or threshold-triggered check KEY, when the latest session at the second lookup differs from the selected target.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Targeted commands should export the requested session. The second lookup is redundant; extracting another session adds unrelated data to the required export.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Resolve the requested session, evaluate its usage where applicable, and produce its declared legacy outputs.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Reuse the validated session metadata or pass the target into compress_session; verify the same key before reading and writing.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep latest-session selection when no target is supplied. Apply the threshold and extraction to the same resolved session.

potential_excess.data_scope: Selected session's AI summary, including decisions and important context
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The routing destination resolved by openclaw agent --to main
potential_excess.condition: --replace when that selector resolves to a destination different from the selected session. Whether this occurs cannot be established from the supplied source.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry promises continuation with the same session key, while its technical recipe and implementation explicitly use --to main.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Inject the compressed summary into the intended replacement session.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a verified target-preserving route; reject unsupported targets before deleting their JSONL rather than sending their summaries to a different destination.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve same-key continuation and backup recovery. OpenClaw routing semantics must be established before choosing the replacement selector.

potential_excess.data_scope: Working-directory path and repository changes/history unrelated to the selected conversation
potential_excess.condition: Legacy compression invoked from a directory or repository whose contents are not needed for the session handoff.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Session continuation requires relevant context. Automatic enrichment from the invoking directory is an implementation choice without a relevance check.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve conversation-derived decisions, state and pending work.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit automatic Git enrichment or include only explicitly relevant repository details; narrow paths, changed files and commit subjects to what continuation needs.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain repository context when it is actually necessary for the selected session's work.

potential_excess.data_scope: Duplicate full-session backups, text transcripts, summaries and continuation excerpts retained beyond their recovery/reference need
potential_excess.condition: Artifacts remain after successful handoff or completed reference use. The package supplies no expiry/pruning path; external cleanup is unknown.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Backup creation and reference exports are declared features. Their creation is necessary for those features; unrestricted subsequent retention is a separate minimization question.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep the required recovery backup and requested reference outputs for their useful period.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Provide retention limits and explicit pruning, allowing shorter-lived transcript/continuation copies after successful use.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve the promised recovery/reference window and explicitly requested archives; never remove the only recovery copy before successful replacement is confirmed.

potential_excess.data_scope: Preexisting last_compression timestamp, including timezone offset, and nonzero total_compressions
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Recipients of the public package's config.json
potential_excess.condition: Distribution of the supplied configuration. Whether these are real activity records or example values is unknown.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Runtime preferences and locally generated activity counters support management; distributing prior activity metadata is not required by the declared workflow.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Ship usable threshold, depth and quiet-hours defaults and initialize per-installation state.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit or null the shipped activity timestamp and initialize the distributed counter to zero.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Change the distribution template without erasing existing installations' intentionally retained history.

unknowns: OpenClaw source and configuration are absent. Actual agent context, model/provider transfers, gateway placement, external logging and retention cannot be determined; no specific remote recipient is established.
The semantics of --to main are absent. This blocks confirming destination mismatch, same-key recreation and the conditional disclosure finding.

The entry calls summarize read-only, but OpenClaw may record the request/response or otherwise mutate session state. The package establishes local summary persistence but cannot resolve external session mutations.
Rollback is not assured: set -e at compress.sh:10–10 can terminate on the failed injection assignment at compress.sh:829–829 before reaching the restoration branch at compress.sh:841–846.
Filesystem permissions, encryption, other-reader access, external cleanup and deletion recoverability are unspecified. The source does not establish actual artifact lifetimes.
Actual session contents and whether packaged activity metadata represents real usage are unknown. No particular credential, sensitive conversation item or real person's activity can be established.
